## What's new

- Home highlights your most recently opened, visible book in a **Continue Reading** row with its cover and source. Tap the row to reopen the book in Duokan or WeRead.
- Home shows up to four other recent books and then your pinned apps. Each section appears only when it has content, and the app count has been removed.
- Apps now uses an icon grid, while the Bookshelf and its folders always show covers. The alternate list layouts and their display settings have been removed.
- Launcher navigation, bookshelf providers, preferences, and reusable views now live in separate packages. The app ID, default launcher component, and existing settings are unchanged.
